scenarios.gate: Approved and executed HybridCPU reset-to-kernel core path.
scenarios.reason: End-to-end reset-vector through kernel entry requires HybridCPU core execution.

scenarios.gate: Named deterministic model tests pass; no hardware claim.
scenarios.reason: Empty selection falls through to signed local recovery in the deterministic model.

scenarios.gate: Selector permutation and invalid-candidate tests pass.
scenarios.reason: Invalid candidates are filtered independently of enumeration order.
BootVolume mismatch is not selected.

scenarios.gate: Replica permutation and duplicate tests pass.
scenarios.reason: Replica resolution is semantic and deterministic.
Same-generation conflicting identities or digests fail as split brain.

scenarios.gate: Host wire-codec CRC and bounds tests pass.
scenarios.reason: Header CRC and bounds are checked before offsets are exposed.

scenarios.gate: Host manifest-envelope malformed-input tests pass; authentication remains separate.
scenarios.reason: Malformed manifest envelope is rejected.
Bad signatures and trust state are rejected.
Destination hash mismatch leaves no executable bytes.

scenarios.gate: CPU ABI owner approves and executes the supported range.
scenarios.reason: Supported CPU ABI policy requires an approved core-owner ABI range.

scenarios.gate: Platform firmware ABI owner approves and executes the supported range.
scenarios.reason: Supported firmware ABI policy requires an approved platform firmware ABI range.
Generation below protected rollback floor is rejected.
Every partial decoder step is compensated in reverse order.
Deadline expiry is deterministic and fail closed.

scenarios.gate: Read/copy fault and RAM-survival tests pass.
scenarios.reason: Read/copy faults expose no partial executable.
Trial confirmation promotes the image and alone advances the floor.
Power loss after payload barrier preserves confirmed/recovery routes.
Power loss around manifest barrier preserves confirmed/recovery routes.
Prepared protected state is never read as a hybrid committed record.
Exhausted trial falls back to confirmed image.

scenarios.gate: Signed local-recovery model route test passes.
scenarios.reason: Signed local recovery is the final executable model route.
Replacement physical evidence does not change logical volume selection.
DSN is preference/evidence unless an exact pin is required.
Selection is permutation invariant.
Exact duplicates are idempotent and conflicts are rejected.
Invalid locator falls back to bounded canonical persistent metadata.
Stale generation is rejected by rollback/selection policy.

scenarios.gate: Local importer performs fresh provider query without authority adoption.
scenarios.reason: SingNext performs fresh provider discovery and treats physical fields as diagnostics.

scenarios.gate: RAM-copy and disappearing-provider tests pass locally.
scenarios.reason: RAM copy survives disappearance while provider admission fails cleanly.
Reset generation makes the previous aperture stale.

scenarios.gate: Watchdog snapshot and trial-attempt tests pass.
scenarios.reason: Watchdog cause and bounded trial-attempt semantics are modeled separately.
Recovery reset reason and signed recovery dispatch are modeled.
Capability loops, duplicates, misalignment and budgets fail closed.
Late and oversized mailbox replies are rejected.
Entry must be aligned and contained in verified loaded bytes.
Overlapping loaded ranges fail with no published component.

scenarios.gate: BootInfo tamper rejection runs before local provider discovery.
scenarios.reason: BootInfo tamper is rejected before discovery.
Unknown optional TLV is skipped.
Unknown required TLV/feature fails closed.

scenarios.gate: Qualified protected store and immutable policy root execute corruption recovery.
scenarios.reason: Both-copy corruption recovery requires a production protected store and immutable policy root.

scenarios.gate: Qualified monotonic store executes floor-corruption behavior.
scenarios.reason: Rollback-floor store corruption behavior requires a production protected store.
Required physical pin rejects; preference-only continues.

scenarios.gate: Route permutation and fresh local provider tests pass.
scenarios.reason: Route changes preserve logical selection and OS provider state is fresh.
RAM/MMIO/reserved overlap is rejected before decoder programming.

scenarios.gate: Capacity/offset range tests pass before modeled read/map.
scenarios.reason: Capacity and offset ranges are checked before read/mapping.

scenarios.gate: Locator fallback plus trust/selection model tests pass.
scenarios.reason: Locator identity cannot replace canonical metadata and signature verification.

scenarios.gate: Development policy plus hardware-enable model test passes.
scenarios.reason: Unsigned images require explicit development policy and hardware enable model input.
Corrupt recovery cannot become executable and model reaches halt when no valid route remains.

scenarios.gate: Bounded deadline and recovery-route model tests pass.
scenarios.reason: All deadlines are bounded and recovery remains reachable in the model.
